Reduced to 6 packages after merging smaller clusters on shared nature. Components D (עזות-קולות, 2 nodes), F (קול-התקיעות, 2 nodes), G (תרועה-שופר-קול-הנגון, 3 nodes) merged into Package 3 (holy boldness + voices) — all are names/forms of holy voice-sounds. Component M (נעשה-ונשמע-שמחה, 2 nodes) merged into Package 1 — the compound נעשה ונשמע IS the joy of Torah acceptance, the same domain as נשמע/תפלה. Component J (צדיק-כלליות-שבעה-רועים, 2 nodes), Component K (חכם-האמת-נשמה-עצם, 3 nodes), and Component L (עם-בשר, 2 nodes) merged into Package 5 — all are aspects of the tzaddik-as-soul-to-the-people relationship (Shepherds = leaders of faith = tzaddikim = soul/bone to the people). Component E (evil-azut, 2 nodes) kept as standalone Package 4 — it is the evil mirror of Package 3 and must remain separate.

packages.label: נִשְׁמָע, תְּפִלָּה וּמַאֲמַר הַשָּׁלֵם — קֹדֶם הַבְּרִיאָה
packages.label_en: Nishma, Prayer and the Complete Utterance — Before Creation
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share a single essential nature: they are names and aspects of the hidden, transcendent dimension — the 'complete utterance' (מאמר השלם) that precedes creation, which is identical to prayer (תפלה) and to Nishma (the hidden/aspirational dimension of divine service). The teaching's core equation is: בראשית = מאמר השלם = נשמע = תפלה = יראה = קדם הבריאה = אין סוף = עדן עלאה = חכמה עלאה = אבא. These are all parallel names for the same transcendent reality: the dimension that cannot yet be fully grasped, that exists before creation, that is oriented toward God in pure devotion without intellectual apprehension. The joy of נעשה ונשמע (merged from isolate M) IS this dimension's experiential form — the moment Israel said 'we will do and we will hear' they entered the domain of this package. The 'nishma'-dimension (hidden Torah, תורת ה', דבורי-התורה-שסביבות-המצוה) is the mystery that surrounds every commandment. בשת, עדן, and the witnesses (הנסתרת-לה-אלהינו, בימי-רבן-גמליאל) all express the same transcendent-hidden quality. ענוה/אין represents the self-nullification that is the essence of this domain.

merge_notes.reason: Isolate M (נעשה ונשמע = שמחה) merged into Package 1 because the compound 'נעשה ונשמע' IS the joyful moment of entering the hidden dimension — 'בשעה שאמרו ישראל נעשה ונשמע, ירדו ששים ריבוא מלאכים... ועתיד הקב"ה להחזירם... ושמחת עולם על ראשם'. The joy of this moment IS the שמחה of entering the transcendent nishma-domain. This is the same reality as נשמע/תפלה — not a cause (the eitza says שמחה → עזות → shepherds), but here as a bechina the compound IS the nature of this package's domain. Both nodes share the essential nature of 'the aspirational, hidden dimension of divine service as experienced in joy.'

packages.label: תּוֹרָה וְנַעֲשֶׂה — הַמַּאֲמַר הַחֲצִי וְהַנִּגְלוֹת
packages.label_en: Torah and Na'ase — The Half-Utterance and the Revealed
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share a single essential nature: they are names and aspects of the manifest, visible, actionable dimension — the 'half utterance' (חצי מאמר) of creation, identified with Torah (the revealed commandments), with Na'ase (we will do — what can be enacted), and with the created world itself. The teaching equates: ברא = חצי מאמר = כלליות הבריאה = חכמה תתאה = עדן תתאה = בן. And: נעשה = נגלות = תורה = תורתו = נגלה. These are parallel names for the same reality: the dimension of divine service that is within reach, graspable, actionable — the world as it can be experienced and commandments as they can be performed. 'נעשה הוא בחינת נגלות, הינו המצוות שאפשר לכל אחד לקיים לפי מדרגתו'. The pair בראשית/ברא maps to the full/half utterance, which maps to father/son (אב ובן), which maps to upper/lower Eden, which maps to hidden/revealed Torah. This package represents the lower, manifest pole of the Torah's central dialectic.

packages.label: עַזּוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה וְקוֹלוֹת — הַשּׁוֹפָר וְהַתְּרוּעָה
packages.label_en: Holy Boldness and Voices — The Shofar and the Teruah
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share a single essential nature: they are all expressions of holy azut (boldness/strength) through voice and sound. The teaching equates: עזות דקדשה = כל הקולות דקדשה = קולות דקדשה = קול שופר = קול נגינה = קול אנחה = תשרי (the month of boldness). And: עזות = קולות (generic holy sounds). And the shofar sounds: קול התקיעות = 'מקול אנחתי', and תרועה = שופר = קול הנגון. 'כל הקולות — הן של צעקה, הן של אנחה, הן קול שופר, הן קול זמרה — כולם הם בחינת עזות'. These are all one domain: the voice-sounds through which holy boldness is expressed and evil-body-boldness is broken. The shofar, groan, song, and trumpet-blast are all aspects of the same holy force. תשרי is the month defined by this quality — 'ירח האיתנים' (month of strength). The disparate sound-types are unified by their shared function: they all ARE holy boldness.

merge_notes.reason: Isolate D (עזות = קולות, 2 nodes) merged into Package 3 because generic 'עזות' IS 'קולות' in the same sense as 'עזות דקדשה' = 'כל הקולות דקדשה'. The parallel is exact — the generic forms of these concepts share the same essential nature as the more specific forms already in the cluster. 'כל הקולות... כולם הם בחינת עזות'.

Isolate F (קול-התקיעות = 'מקול-אנחתי', 2 nodes) merged into Package 3 because the shofar-blasts ARE the groaning voice of holy azut. 'ובחינת קול התקיעות הוא בחינת מקול אנחתי' — the trumpet sounds ARE the sighing-voice. This is the same domain of holy voice-sounds as the rest of Package 3.

Isolate G (תרועה = שופר = קול-הנגון, 3 nodes) merged into Package 3 because תרועה, שופר and the melody-voice are the same type of holy voice-sounds. 'תרועה — בחינת ואתה תרעה את עמי' = the sound that brings one to the holy shepherds. קול הנגון IS תרועה. All are aspects of the same holy voice/boldness domain.

packages.label: עַזּוּת דְּסִטְרָא אָחֳרָא — עַזּוּת הַגּוּף
packages.label_en: Evil Boldness — The Boldness of the Body
packages.reason: These two nodes share a single essential nature: they are the evil mirror of holy boldness (Package 3). The teaching explicitly distinguishes two types of azut: the holy azut of voices and prayer, and the evil azut of the body's appetites and the sitra achra's false leaders. 'כי עזות — מלכותא בלא תגא' (shameless kingship). 'הכלבים עזי נפש המה רועים' — the evil shepherds rule through this bodily-azut. This is the structural evil-counterpart of Package 3: same concept (boldness), opposite orientation (sitra achra vs. holiness). They are the obstacle that holy voices/azut must overcome.

packages.label: רַגְלִין, מוֹכִיחִים וְשִׁבְעָה רוֹעִים — הֶחָכָם וְהָעָם
packages.label_en: Legs, Rebukers and Seven Shepherds — The Wise Man and the People
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share a single essential nature: they are the tzaddikim/shepherds/leaders who stand between God and Israel, and the structural relationship between the wise man (soul/bone) and the people (flesh/body). Specifically: רגלים = המוכיחים = מוכיחי הדור (the feet/legs of the divine structure = the rebukers who go as God's emissaries). And: צדיק = כלליות שבעה רועים (the tzaddik who embodies all seven shepherds). And: חכם האמת = נשמה להעם = עצם (the true wise man IS the soul to the people IS the bone). And: עם = בשר (the people are the flesh/body). These are all aspects of the same structural reality: the tzaddik as the living connection between the divine (soul/bone) and the people (flesh), who rebuke and lead by going as God's messengers. The rebukers ARE the legs because they walk on God's behalf. The seven shepherds ARE the collective tzaddik. This package embodies the outer, walking, leading dimension of holiness — distinct from the inner seal (faith/Package 6) that they help fill.

merge_notes.reason: Isolate J (צדיק = כלליות-שבעה-רועים) merged into Package 5 because the tzaddik IS the embodiment of the seven shepherds — same essential nature as the Rebukers/Legs cluster. The seven shepherds are the concrete form of what it means to be a רגל (leg/emissary) of God. 'כי ראה לפניו כלליות שבעה רועים' — the tzaddik who represents all the shepherds IS the source from which the rebukers draw.

Isolate K (חכם-האמת = נשמה-להעם = עצם) merged into Package 5 because the true wise man IS the soul to the people IS the bone in the soul-body relationship — which is the tzaddik-people relationship structurally. 'החכם האמת, שהוא בחינת הנשמה להעם... הוא בחינת עצם'. This is the same domain as the shepherds/rebukers — the tzaddik as the animating force (soul/bone) of the people (flesh). They share the essential nature of holy leadership.

Isolate L (עם = בשר, people = flesh) merged into Package 5 because the people ARE the flesh in the tzaddik-people relationship, which is the central structural metaphor of this package. 'והעם הם נגדו בחינת בשר'. The people's nature (as flesh to the wise man's bone) belongs in the same package as the wise man/soul/bone cluster — they form the two poles of a single structural relationship.

packages.label: אֱמוּנָה וִירוּשָׁלַיִם — חוֹתָם הַיָּדַיִם
packages.label_en: Faith and Jerusalem — The Seal of the Hands
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share a single essential nature: they are names and aspects of faith (אמונה) — the inner seal of holiness that is the hands' quality (חותם הידין). The teaching equates: אמונה = חותם הידין (faith = the inner seal — 'הידים זה בחינת אמונה'). And: אמונה = ירושלים = קריה נאמנה (faith = Jerusalem the faithful city). And: אמונה שלמה = ירושלים. Faith is what the seven shepherds tend ('ורעה אמונה'). Faith-Jerusalem is the culminating state of holiness toward which the entire Torah's argument flows. It is the 'inner seal' that must be protected — the שמירה יתרה of the teaching. This package is the goal/telos of the Torah's argument: after rebukers seal judgments → hands receive in faith → shepherds fill the hands → voices/boldness bring one to the shepherds → faith/Jerusalem is achieved.

stats.torah_argument: Pkg 5 (Rebukers/Legs) seals judgments → Pkg 6 (Faith/Hands) receives via Shepherds → Pkg 3 (Holy Boldness/Voices) enables approach to Shepherds, defeating Pkg 4 (Evil-Azut/Body) → Pkg 1 (Nishma/Prayer) is the transcendent source, Pkg 2 (Torah/Na'ase) is its manifest form
